name: com.uayten.unityblenderlike
description: Makes the Unity Scene view feel like Blender: modal G / R / S that follow the mouse, with X / Y / Z axis locks and typed values, Blender's object keys (hide, clear transforms, duplicate and move, parent, select all), Blender's numpad views with local view and Auto Perspective, and a Transform Inspector that shows Blender's Z-up values, matching models exported from Blender. Editor-only, installable per machine without touching the project.
